# cloudformation

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//cloudformation:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//cloudformation:defs.bzl", "cloudformation_library")
```

## Rules

### `cloudformation_library`

Owns the CloudFormation templates of one package for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | CloudFormation template files of this package; each needs a top-level Resources section. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Other template libraries this package depends on. |
